Bitnomial's XRP collateral announcement predates the Coinbase request, so the request did not cause the original XRP collateral support. Bitnomial currently lists XRP at 40% haircut/$15M notional limit; Payward acquired Bitnomial. Coinbase FCM XRP use, direct Coinbase/Bitnomial clearing, actual balances, $15M cap scope and current RLUSD acceptance remain unknown.
